items.title: GTA 6 Players Are Refusing to Make Use of an Infinite Money Glitch They Say Ruins the Experience
items.description: Some GTA 6 players are refusing to make use of an infinite money glitch they say ruins the experience Rockstar set out to provide.
items.author: Kirk McKeand
items.content:
Players have already found ways to farm infinite money, undermining the carefully paced economy of GTA 6 using multiple methods. While this happens with every game, it’s particularly strange here.

Why is it weird? GTA 6 already has infinite money. You can rob as many stores and businesses as you like and fence the goods, and while stores close down for a while after they’ve been robbed, they reset on a frequent basis.

You just have to play as intended, but some players are hellbent on farming cash in the most mind-numbing ways possible. The methods are all built around forcing the store closure timers to reset, so you can rob the same stores on repeat.

First, they rob a bunch of stores and collect as much as possible, then they trigger a mission to start a cutscene. Once the cutscene begins, they restart the mission from the menu. When the cutscene begins again, they quit out of the mission, which forces all the stores to reset.

Honestly, it sounds arduous and you’d be better off exploring to find new robbery opportunities so you can experience fresh gameplay.

Another method sees players go to a lucrative building, get all of the money and narcotics from inside, and store them in the trunk of their car. Next they save the game and immediately load it up. The bags remain in your car, but the building’s loot resets, allowing you to rinse and repeat.

Most players agree that this is probably the worst way to experience GTA 6. “Nah I’m good! Didn’t wait 13 years just to glitch my way through the game,” said one fan.

“Takes away from the experience,” another poster agreed. “The games (sic) way too immersive to just skip the grind, takes the fun out of it.” Another said: “Nah I prefer to just, ya know, play the game and earn it.”

There are seemingly dozens of variations of this glitch, with the method slightly varying between them. In another, the player robs a different location and fences the goods before saving and reloading to reset the location’s loot.

Again, this genuinely seems like a miserable way to play the game — especially since more exciting and lucrative robbery opportunities open up as you progress through the story. It’s also probably just a matter of time until Rockstar patches it out.

items.title: Some GTA 6 Players Think Max Weight Jason and Lucia Aren't Big Enough
items.description: Some GTA 6 players really want Jason and Lucia to be able to get as fat as CJ from GTA: San Andreas.
items.author: Rhiannon Bevan
items.content:
Given all of the intricate details that have gone into GTA 6, it came as no surprise whatsoever to see body transformations return.

This means that Jason and Lucia's bodies will change based on how much exercise you're giving them and what you're feeding them. Like in Red Dead Redemption 2, this impacts your stats in combat, so it's well worth keeping an eye on your health app. (Check out IGN's guide, Fitness and Wellness Explained in GTA 6, for more.)

However, also much like with Red Dead Redemption 2, a lot of players were looking forward to getting Jason and Lucia as big as possible, purely for aesthetic reasons. More than a few of us had Jason dual-wielding cheeseburgers in Chapter 1 (yes, you can do that), to bulk him up as quickly as we can.

Now, the results are in, and some players were left feeling underwhelmed.

multiple of my mutuals just decided they won’t buy this game because she isn’t fat enough

— Cybernetic Frantsuz (@boris_molotov) November 19, 2026

@jsmekuro_ The funny thing is Max Weight Arthur in RDR2 looks beefier/fatter than Jason so he got a bit of a nerf there https://t.co/GqtdVrfjnW

— Sir Joseph Windsor (@SirJosephWindsr) November 19, 2026

@HeavyGungnir THERE IS NO FAT LUCIA MF HERE IS PROOF FROM MY PLAYTHROUGH THE MAX BODY FAT IS ONLY 142 YOU ALL GOT SCAMMED https://t.co/MUB52xDuhI

— FanOfSonic4Life (@FanOfSonic4Life) November 19, 2026

Fat Jason has his fans, but it looks like everyone is universally disappointed with fat Lucia capping at 142 pounds (about 10 stone, or 64.4kg). And even if fat Jason is bigger, he's got nothing on the Rockstar protagonists who came before him, like Arthur Morgan.

The saving grace here is that getting chubby in GTA 6 is a lot easier than it was in Red Dead Redemption 2. Fast food and junk food can be found down most streets in Leonida, right from the get go. There are no cooldowns on how much you can eat at home, either.

And yet, there's one Rockstar protagonist who has them all beat: CJ from GTA: San Andreas.

@SirJosephWindsr *laughs in fat CJ* https://t.co/Qg8pzAE7EP

— DRichous (@DRichous) November 19, 2026

There is already talk of modders rectifying all of this once GTA 6 is available on PC. I imagine it would be one of many, many cosmetic mods for the game once modders have it in their hands. What do you think of max weight Jason and Lucia? Would you have liked to see them able to get bigger? Let us know in the comments below!

items.title: 'Cousin! We Should Hang Out!' GTA Secret Quests Referencing Roman Bellic Added to Fortnite
items.description: Fortnite has added a series of secret GTA quests referencing GTA 4's Roman Bellic and the game's memorable "Cousin! We should hang out!" meme.
items.author: Tom Phillips
items.content:
Fortnite has added a series of secret GTA quests referencing GTA 4's Roman Bellic and his memorable "Cousin! We should hang out!" meme.

Epic Games' battle royale flipped the switch to activate the six secret quests yesterday, the official day of GTA 6's release, allowing players to receive a series of fresh tasks from Peely the banana in exchange for a whopping 120,000 XP.

These quests all reference GTA 4 — and Roman Bellic's frequent harassment of his cousin, protagonist Nico Bellic — by having Fortnite players pick up the phone to Peely, who requests they complete a nearby task. Fittingly, one of Peely's quests involves knocking over a set of bowling pins — a nod to how Roman would call to invite Nico to go bowling with him. "Cousin! We should hang out!" reads the quest's on-screen description.

Other quests direct players to encounter various existing Easter eggs present on Fortnite's current map, including hidden treasure caves, a Zelda-like statue puzzle, and a cute rubber duck race.

[GUIDE] Complete #Fortnite's Secret Peely Phone Call Quests, referencing GTA IV's Roman Bellic!

- Hit the pins

- Solve Puzzle of the Frogs

- Start Duck Race

- Find Cenote Treasure

- Find Lighthouse Treasure

- Find Super Secret Cave

🎁 Reward: 120,000 XP

⏰Ends Dec 5th, 4pm ET https://t.co/AikNexWas8

— FNAssist (@FN_Assist) November 19, 2026

Fortnite is currently weathering the launch of GTA 6 fairly well, with player numbers for the game's main evergreen battle royale mode still in the millions despite Rockstar's masterpiece launching this week. Epic Games has done well to build up interest in Fortnite's current season by dangling the oppurtunity to unlock a fortnight of entirely free access to the game's lucrative item shop, something players are now grinding for in huge numbers.

As for GTA 6 itself, Rockstar is yet to reveal exactly how well the game has sold — though it's clear the game has been a huge success, just from the estimated 20 million pre-order copies that the game shifted before launch.

items.title: Can Jason and Lucia Get Naked in GTA 6?
items.description: Let’s settle this once and for all. Can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6?
items.author: Wesley Yin-Poole
items.content:
Let’s settle this once and for all. Can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6?

Ever since the couple were revealed as the co-protagonists of GTA 6, it feels like that one question has been asked more than any other. Not, “How will the robbery gameplay systems work?” or, “Does the driving feel as exquisitely dangerous as it did in GTA 4?,” but instead, people just want to know how much skin will be on show.

Who am I to judge? Upon booting up GTA 6 for the first time, within its opening hours I’d already located one nudist bar and spent a little too long examining the variety of appendages on show. There’s no shortage of NPC nudity out there in Leonida. People walk along beaches, run out into the street, and sit by pools with no clothes covering their decency. But, how about Jason and Lucia?

Just getting started in GTA 6 or wondering what to do next? Check out the Official Grand Theft Auto 6 guide right here on IGN. If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks, or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips. If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map.

Can Jason and Lucia get naked in GTA 6?

Showering can (and should, if you don’t want to stink) play a huge part in your daily routine in GTA 6. Not only does it boost your focus bar, but can have other gameplay ramifications, such as enemy humans and animals being able to pick up your scent more easily.

Of course, showering should be done with no clothes on — unless you’re playing the Japanese version of Grand Theft Auto 6, that is — and you can scrub up both Jason and Lucia from a camera view deliberately angled so you don’t get a good look around the front of them. I’m sure you’ve tried by now if you’re reading this, but no matter how forcefully you push that right stick, you’ll never get the angle you’re looking for. GTA 6 simply does not want you to see its lead character’s genitals. They bare their soul in their epic story, so this is the least grace we can give them.

Sex can play a big part in Jason and Lucia’s story if you choose to engage in it, though. Build a strong enough relationship between them, and you’ll occasionally get a prompt to engage in a spot of physical intimacy, whether that be in bed, in the shower, on the sofa, or other spots around the house. While, again, these scenes aren’t overly explicit with full frontal nudity never on show, both can be naked, with topless scenes not uncommon. If nipples are what you’re seeking, you shall find them.

So, can you see Jason and Lucia naked? Yes, and no. Intimate scenes often involve no clothes, but you’re never going to come close to watching a porn film here. That would just be odd.

The least you can ever walk around your home wearing is underwear, and if you try to leave the house, further clothes will be magically added to your character to spare their decency. Despite some wild and weird things available for you to find in GTA 6’s open world, it ultimately does want you to treat its leads as real humans, not complete freaks. Despite what some past leaks may have suggested, you can’t roam the streets of Vice City completely nude for all the world to see. You are, however, free to do that in real life, but you will likely end up in jail.

We have plenty more GTA 6 coverage for you at IGN, from letting you know how long the game takes to beat to the optional missions you really shouldn’t miss.

items.title: GTA 6's Full Credits Spark Returning Character Rumor — Are They Really in the Game?
items.description: GTA 6's full credits have sparked a rumor about a returning character. Are they really in the game?
items.author: Wesley Yin-Poole
items.content:
Warning! This article contains a major spoiler for the GTA 6 story.

GTA 6 is finally here, and players are already devouring it, finding each and every one of its secrets and surprises at a rapid pace. We have no doubt that some are so well-hidden that we won’t discover them for weeks, months, or even years, but when it comes to others, the cat is firmly out of the bag.

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks, or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips. If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map.

Why is everyone suddenly talking about Niko Bellic in GTA 6?

Well, yesterday, developer Rockstar finally revealed the GTA 6 credits. Within that long, long webpage is the full cast of actors and the characters they play in the game. One name was snuck in right at the bottom, though. One that would mean a lot to long-term fans of the series: Michael Hollick.

Hollick, for those not well-versed in GTA’s past, voiced the Grand Theft Auto 4 protagonist, Niko Bellic. So, assumptions have been made that the beloved character may well make an appearance in GTA 6. In the credits, the actor is listed as playing someone simply listed as ‘The Hitman.’ The burning question is: Does Niko Bellic have a cameo, or maybe even a larger role in Jason and Lucia’s story, or is this mystery hitman an original character?

Really, do not read past this point if you don’t want any late-game spoilers for GTA 6. While I will not go into what it means for Jason and Lucia’s story, I will be talking about a major surprise you might want to experience yourself. You have been warned.

Is Niko Bellic in GTA 6?

Yes, ‘The Hitman’ is indeed Niko Bellic. That pseudonym makes a lot of sense — he spends much of his time in GTA 4’s story as a gun for hire, bringing his military experience in the Yugoslav Wars to the streets of Liberty City. And from the looks of him here and the situation we find him in, not a whole lot has changed in the intervening 18 years.

Niko is still heavily involved in the criminal underworld, albeit just dealing with his business with a few extra grey hairs these days, and has been called to Vice City to help eradicate a problem for the people he’s working for. I won’t go into what this means for GTA 6’s tale or how Jason and Lucia find their story connecting to another of the series’ protagonists, but I will confirm that it's all highly enjoyable for the short time we get to meet Mr Bellic again. Sadly, that doesn’t involve going bowling with his cousin.

GTA 4 and Niko are incredibly beloved at this point, with people often citing him as the strongest Grand Theft Auto protagonist to this day. It was a turning point for a more mature era of Rockstar storytelling, ultimately leading to the more empathetic nature of GTA 6’s story. Only time will tell if either Jason or Lucia will be held in such regard as 2008’s Liberty City immigrant with a dream, as more and more people finish their story.

That being said, if you’re someone reading this who has either finished GTA 6, or isn’t fussed about cameo spoilers, please don’t share this with others who you know won’t want to know this information. GTA 6 is a special game, so letting others enjoy it at their own pace with all its secrets and surprises still held up its sleeve is the kindest thing you could do.

GTA 6 is a special game, so letting others enjoy it at their own pace with all its secrets and surprises still held up its sleeve is the kindest thing you could do.

items.title: Ubisoft Says Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey Boosted Assassin's Creed Odyssey Sales
items.description: Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey sparked a fresh surge in back-catalog sales for 2018's Assassin's Creed Odyssey, Ubisoft has said.
items.author: Tom Phillips
items.content:
Christopher Nolan's The Odyssey sparked a fresh surge in back-catalog sales for 2018's Assassin's Creed Odyssey, Ubisoft has said.

In its latest financial results briefing, the Assassin's Creed publisher noted how a "major summer movie" had "materially benefited" the continued sales of its brilliant Ancient Greek game. Over the summer, Ubisoft re-promoted Assassin's Creed Odyssey alongside the launch of Nolan's film, inviting players to go start their own epic journey for themselves after returning home from theaters.

Once again, Ubisoft used its financial update to praise the evergreen sales of its Assassin's Creed back catalog. Also, once again, it failed to provide any further detail on how last year's Assassin's Creed Shadows had fared. There's a sense that the long-awaited feudal Japan blockbuster has been a commercial disappointment for Ubisoft, and it's been a while since we had any formal update on sales numbers. No further content for the game is on the way, either — even though 2020's Valhalla just got a New Game Plus mode.

Indeed, Shadows is not mentioned at all in the results, despite Ubisoft commenting on Odyssey, Valhalla (which also just passed 40 million players), and this year's Assassin’s Creed Black Flag Resynced — the latter of which has clearly had a successful launch.

Ubisoft attributes an outperformance in its latest financial results to Resynced, which it describes as having been "among the industry's most successful Action-Adventure remakes." How did its launch compare to any all-new Assassin's Creed games? If it did surpass any of those, Ubisoft perhaps understandably isn't saying — but it's clear the game has been a hit.

"The franchise will celebrate its 20th anniversary next year," Ubisoft said, reiterating what fans have heard already — that 2027 should be a more exciting year for the series than the past 12 months have been. "This is a major milestone for the brand, which is preparing a year of reveals, updates, rewards, and community
moments."

It seems likely that next year will be when we get a first glimpse of the upcoming Assassin's Creed Hexe, the series' next blockbuster game, as well as Netflix's upcoming Assassin's Creed TV series set in Ancient Rome and a peek at Codename Invictus, a new multiplayer game spinoff. Until then, well, Assassin's Creed: Odyssey is really worth a go if you haven't played it already.

items.title: GTA 6 Players Find Red Dead Redemption Lore That Strongly Suggests Both Series Are Set in the Same Universe
items.description: Players have found lore in GTA 6 that strongly suggest the game takes place in the same universe as Rockstar’s Red Dead Redemption series, in a move that has excited fans about the prospect of a canon merger of timelines.
items.author: Kirk McKeand
items.content:
Players have found lore in GTA 6 that strongly suggest the game takes place in the same universe as Rockstar’s Red Dead Redemption series, in a move that has excited fans about the prospect of a canon merger of timelines.

Warning! Spoilers for GTA 6 and Red Dead Redemption 2 follow.

We’ve already found Arthur Morgan’s hat in GTA 6, but there’s another thing connecting the two games. A readable book found in Brian’s Marina in Key Lento has multiple references to Red Dead Redemption and its sequel. X / Twitter user GameRoll shared excerpts from the book online. The book is a chronicle of the life and death of Flaco Hernandez, a gunslinger Arthur Morgan hunts to his cabin by Cairn Lake in Grizzlies West during the The Noblest of Men, and a Woman stranger mission in RDR 2. The book itself could even be the chronicle you help Theodore Levin write by hunting down the gunslingers, or at least a modern reinterpretation of it.

It’s told from the viewpoint of Rust McCreary, an original character who doesn’t appear in either RDR game. In the book, he comes across the corpse of Hernandez in the snow at Cairn Lake, right where you leave him in the RDR 2 mission.

According to the book, Hernandez had a bullet hole right in the center of his forehead, so it’s canon that you can actually aim good. The book also references multiple locations, from New Austin to Armadillo and Blackwater.

It’s not quite confirmation that Jason is a direct descendant of Arthur Morgan or anything like that, but it’s a cool detail that basically turns RDR into a prequel to GTA 4 and its sequels. Like Dutch, Rockstar had a plan all along. Players have even found license plates for New Austin in GTA 6. New Austin is one of the states in which Red Dead takes place, and is assumed to be Rockstar's version of Texas.

It's not the first time Rockstar has connected the games. In the first iteration of GTA Online, the character creator allowed you to share genetics with John Marston, protagonist of the first RDR, to create a visual basis for your original character. Fans of the two games are generally happy with the connection. "Honestly? Good," said one X / Twitter user. "I was annoyed that technically both canons weren't linked. By linking them, it makes the universe feel bigger."

"That is so cool," said another. "This GTA trully feels like RDR. And I really enjoy the calmer aproach I even try to be as good with jason to give them the better possible ending." Another social media user wasn't as convinced because of characters in older Rockstar games mentioning California and Florida, instead of their in-universe names of San Andreas and Leonida: "It’s weird though, because in Red Dead Redemption 2 they call certain states or cities by their real names, but in GTA they use fictionalized names of cities and states. So many retcons it’s painful."

If you're still getting your bearings, discover GTA's new systems with the Beginner's Guide - 67 Tips and Tricks, or get all the details on the first chapters with the Chapter 1 Guide and Tips and Chapter 2 Guide and Tips. If you're already driving all around Leonida and want to know everything there is to find and do, see the Leonida interactive map.

items.title: Rosario Dawson Shows First Look at Return as Claire Temple in Spider-Man: Brand New Day Extended Cut
items.description: Rosario Dawson has shared the first look at her return as Claire Temple in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, marking her long-awaited comeback to the MCU.
items.author: Tom Phillips
items.content:
Rosario Dawson has shared the first look at her return as Claire Temple in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, marking her long-awaited comeback to the MCU.

Warning! Spoilers for Spider-Man: Brand New Day follow...

Posting on Instagram, Dawson revealed a photo of her in costume for her first Marvel appearance in a decade, standing in nurse scrubs next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man. It's a scene that fans thought they'd never get to see, after it was deleted from the final cut of the movie, disappointing those waiting for Dawson's reappearance.

Now, however, it is being reinstated for the film's extended edition re-release, entitled Spider-Man: [Brand New] Brand New Day, alongside a handful of other moments previously left on the cutting room floor.

"It's a brand new BRAND NEW DAY with our friendly neighborhood Spider-Man...!" Dawson wrote. "So excited to enjoy this record-breaking movie on the big screen (starting on December 4th) with an extended cut of new scenes and surprises… Ahhhh!

"Join me in getting tickets NOW!!!" Dawson continued. "PS: mom can finally share her bts photos❣️"

It's pretty obvious when this scene will take place, as Dawson's character stands next to Tom Holland's Spider-Man who is wearing a hospital gown and his Spidey mask. Of course, Spider-Man finds himself in hospital towards the end of the movie, and Dawson's return will likely answer fan questions surrounding how the superhero got patched up with no one else discovering his identity. (The answer, surely, is that Dawson takes care of him directly — having been used to keeping numerous superhero identities secret in the past.)

Debuting in the very first season of Daredevil back in 2015, Dawson’s no-nonsense nurse quickly became an indispensable ally across its sister Netflix shows: Jessica Jones, Luke Cage, Iron Fist, and The Defenders. Whether she was patching up Matt Murdock in a dimly lit apartment, helping Luke Cage navigate Harlem, or standing her ground against The Hand, Claire earned a fan following for her work sewing up the wounds of New York's vigilante community.

However, after her appearance in the second season of Luke Cage in 2018, Dawson stepped away from the role, leaving fans wondering for years whether Claire Temple would ever cross paths with the broader MCU. With Charlie Cox’s Matt Murdock and Jon Bernthal’s Frank Castle re-entering the fold, Dawson’s return felt like a missing puzzle piece — and Spider-Man: Brand New Day is finally delivering on that promise.

Spider-Man: Brand New Day will be back in theaters on December 4, 2026, now with Rosario Dawson included. What else has Marvel added back into the movie? You'll just have to go along and find out.

Image credit: Paul Archuleta/FilmMagic.

items.title: Cyberleek Returns for GTA 6 Launch to Reportedly Release a Near-Complete Xbox Build, Threatens to Release the Game's Executable in Days
items.description: Cyberleek has returned for the launch of GTA 6 to allegedly release a near complete Xbox build of the game — and has threatened to release its executable in just days.
items.author: Wesley Yin-Poole
items.content:
Cyberleek has returned for the launch of GTA 6 to allegedly release a near complete Xbox build of the game — and has threatened to release its executable in just days.

It was thought that the person or group responsible for the online Cyberleek persona had ended their spate of GTA 6 leaks last month, after their memecoin crashed despite efforts to boost its market cap.

In October, Cyberleek had tied various types of GTA 6 gameplay leaks to the Cyberleek market cap, and threatened to release a build of the game — supposedly over 200 GB in size — if the memecoin hit a $30 million market cap. Gameplay clips reportedly leaked at the time allegedly showed Lucia fully naked — something that is not possible in the final launch version of the game.

Yesterday, November 19 — the GTA 6 release date — Cyberleek returned to drop a GTA 6 Xbox build without the game's executable. In a statement reportedly published online, Cyberleek claimed this Xbox build is a “full November 2026 build of GTA 6.” They predicted this Xbox build would be used to emulate GTA 6 on PC “within a week, running far past 30fps.”

The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5 and Xbox Series X and S.

Cyberleek has revived their crypto scheme, promising to release the executable immediately if it hits a $15 million market cap. While the CyberLeek memecoin was boosted in value by the news to $1.9 million yesterday, it is unlikely to get anywhere near the target.

Still, Cyberleek has vowed to release the final file anyway on November 23, whether the memecoin hits the market cap or not.

The release of a full and recent build of GTA 6 would of course be hugely damaging for Rockstar and parent company Take-Two, which appears to have been unable to deter Cyberleek’s actions in any meaningful way since their spate of leaks began.

It would also run counter to the thought that Cyberleek only had access to an early development build of GTA 6, a feeling that was reinforced not only by the videos that were released, but by the differences that have emerged following the game’s official launch.

Fans are calling on people not to spend money on Cyberleek, pointing out the leaker cashed out back in August and did again in October. Analysis of cryptocurrency transactions in late August pointed to the GTA 6 leaker cashing out having earnt around $270,000.

IGN had reported on fan skepticism around the alleged leaked gameplay that reportedly showed both Jason and Lucia fully naked. A previous leaked gameplay video allegedly showed a tank spawning into the world, which suggested access to a dev menu of some kind. The leaked videos allegedly showing both Jason and Lucia fully naked also show NPCs failing to react to that in any way, which suggested this effect was achieved with either a dev menu or cheats.

Cyberleek had threatened Rockstar and Take-Two with the release of a full playthrough of the game’s story if they failed to release GTA 6 on-disc and issue a public apology — and the market cap of the memecoin hit $30 million. Of course, few believe these GTA 6 leaks are about campaigning for physical media — rather they're about making money from a crypto scam.

Cyberleek appeared to go dark after a spate of high-profile GTA 6 leaks in August that sparked an investigation from Take-Two. The company issued subpoenas to the likes of Discord as part of the hunt for the person or group of people responsible. It remains unclear how the gameplay footage, or any potential build of the game it's taken from, escaped the confines of Rockstar's infamous tight security.

In August, Rockstar addressed the GTA 6 leaks, describing the situation as "heartbreaking" for its development team and "unfortunate" for fans. At the time, the developer acknowledged that its intended experience for players "may now be impacted by some spoilers," but reiterated GTA 6's previously-confirmed launch date of November 19.

Whether the culprit or culprits are ever caught may rest on how successful Take-Two's legal team and the relevant authorities are at forcing social networks or crypto exchanges to divulge any personal details they hold on those responsible.

items.title: Lanterns Star Aaron Pierre Addresses His DCU Future: 'What Will Be Will Be'
items.description: Lanterns star Aaron Pierre had already reprised his role as Green Lantern John Stewart for the 2027 film Man of Tomorrow when the news broke that DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran had been fired by new parent company Skydance. Whether his appearance will remain in the final film now that there’s a new regime in charge of DC, Pierre says, “I’m very at peace. What will be will be.”
items.author: Jim Vejvoda
items.content:
Lanterns star Aaron Pierre had already reprised his role as Green Lantern John Stewart for the 2027 film Man of Tomorrow when the news broke that DC Studios bosses James Gunn and Peter Safran had been fired by new parent company Skydance. Whether his appearance will remain in the final film now that there’s a new regime in charge of DC, Pierre says, “I’m very at peace. What will be will be.”

In a podcast chat with IndieWire recorded the same day the news about Gunn and Safran broke, Pierre says, “Well, I actually only just found out the news prior to logging on so I haven’t very much time at all to process the enormity of that news. But what I can say is that my relationship with James and my relationship with Peter is a beautiful relationship and I’ve really loved every moment collaborating with them and working with them and getting to know them. And I’m excited to, beyond this point, in a different context, collaborate with them again and I’m also excited to see what happens next for DC.”

The Superman sequel Man of Tomorrow was in post-production when Gunn and Safran were removed from their posts. It didn’t take long for the online rumor mill to flood the internet with claims that Skydance was going to remove many of the cameos from Man of Tomorrow, namely Supergirl and Blue Beetle. John Stewart is among the DC heroes set to appear in the film.

Gunn, though, shot down all such claims of studio meddling, stating that no one at Skydance has even seen the film yet. "There are a lot of untrue rumors going around, but one of them is that Skydance has seen Man of Tomorrow and that all sorts of sweeping changes are being made," Gunn posted. "No one from Skydance has even seen the movie - the only people that have are Peter Safran and a very small trusted group of friends and family. So any stories around this narrative are false."

It remains unclear what DC Studios’ future looks like until Jeremy Latcham, the incoming President and Chief Creative Officer of DC Studios, takes his post on December 1. For his part, Pierre is remaining zen about what’s in store for Man of Tomorrow and DC’s future. (The status of Lanterns Season 2 also remains up in the air.)

“I think for me, you know, we did the film and we really loved every moment of doing the film and what happens beyond this point is not my decision. So I’m very at peace,” Pierre tells IndieWire.

“What will be will be. But what I do know is that those friendships will last beyond this point and also those artistic creative, working collaboration relationships will live beyond this point as well. And as I say, I’m excited to see where DC goes from here.”

Until Latcham says otherwise, fans can only suspect things are back to square one again lest they heed some fans’ advice not to reboot the DCU again. If that’s it for Gunn and Safran’s “Gods and Monsters” saga then why should fans be invested in Man of Tomorrow if it no longer matters? It will likely just collapse at the box office like The Flash did after Gunn ended the DCEU.

items.description: GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes.
items.author: Cade Onder
items.content:
GTA 6's popularity has led to police departments around the United States pleading with citizens to not commit real crimes.

GTA 6 is finally here, and you can carry out many of your wildest criminal fantasies. It's a very freeing experience, and Rockstar has added more depth than ever before to make crimes like simple robberies more intricate and nuanced. However, the usual suspects when it comes to a new GTA game (mainstream news outlets, like Fox News) have expressed concern over what kind of impact this might have on society. Will it create real rampant crime or spikes in violence? Probably not, but police departments across the country have created PSAs to ask people not to commit crime.

The Atlanta Police Department put out a post asking people to express their more radical desires in-game and not in real life.

GTA is not a real place, but Atlanta is!🎮

Don't confuse virtual entertainment with real-life decisions.

Drunk driving, reckless driving, auto theft and violence have real consequences.

Keep it in the game. Don't bring it to our streets. https://t.co/Y7PdJFHLsZ

— Atlanta Police Department (@Atlanta_Police) November 17, 2026

The police department in San Juan, Texas have asked players to keep their behavior in-game, noting that a six star wanted level in real life is not a challenge, but a criminal jail sentence.

It's a bit of fun to likely ride the GTA 6 hype wave. You'd be hard pressed to find a major company that isn't trying to capture GTA 6's excitement in some way right now, and it seems like even local governments are doing the same thing. As is always the case with GTA, there are some folks expressing concern over the game's contents. One concerned group in particular is the furry community, which is mocked in-game. Furries are illegal in GTA 6 and as a result, the police hunt them down and point weapons at them. It's pretty absurd, but some real furries don't find it very amusing.

This is all par for the course for this franchise, but it does seem like more non-gamers are trying to have fun with it since it's such a massive cultural event. As of right now, we don't know how well GTA 6 has sold, but it looks like it's going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history.

items.title: The Apple TV Black Friday Deal Gets You 6 Months of Ad-free Streaming for Half the Price
items.author: Jacob Kienlen
items.content:
Apple has officially revealed its streaming deal for 2026 and it's the best discount we've seen so far on an ad-free plan. New and eligible returning subscribers can get Apple TV for $6.99 per month for the first six months of their subscription. This is half the price of what the service usually costs, thanks to a fairly recent price increase bumping monthly plans up to $14.99/mo.

This promotion is available now and is currently set to end on November 30, 2026 at precisely 8pm PT. If you're hoping to save on streaming subscriptions heading into next year, this deal is a great way to do so. Just make sure you grab it before the end of Cyber Monday.

Apple TV Black Friday Deal Details

Apple TV has seen a pretty drastic price increase since it first launched, but it makes sense when you look at the number of high-quality original shows are on the platform now. You've got massive hits like Severance and Ted Lasso as well as some of the best new sci-fi shows like Silo and Murderbot. If you've never had an Apple TV subscription, there's a lot of really good TV you could watch in that six-month window.

If you're a returning subscriber, there's plenty to look forward to on the service as well. The slate of November releases includes Owen Wilson's golf series and a feel-good Chris Pratt movie. The highly anticipated Neuromancer series is also set to arrive in January 2027. Apple is also relatively good about consistently putting out new seasons of its most popular shows, so every month has at least something decent to watch.

What Returning Subscribers Are Eligible?

The details about which returning subscribers are actually eligible for this discount isn't super clear. Apple states that users will not be able to get the discount if they are already eligible for the three month free trial or if your subscription is billed through a third party. You may also need to have a large enough gap since your last subscription ended to get the discounts. Some users have noted that if you haven't had a subscription in over a year, you count as a "qualified" returning subscriber.

More Black Friday Streaming Deals

Not all of the Black Friday streaming deals have gone live, but a number of other services have also kicked off their discounts alongside Amazon's official sale. Crunchyroll is discounting all of its subscription tiers by up to 60% and Paramount+ is offering the first two months of it's plans for $2.99 per month. These subscriptions are also available at a discount via Prime Video add-ons, though the same restrictions apply there too.

items.title: GTA 6's Viral NPC May Actually Have a Dark Secret
items.description: A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral since the game's launch for being a total smokeshow, but she also seems to have a dark secret.
items.author: Cade Onder
items.content:
Warning: Spoilers for GTA 6 ahead!

A character in GTA 6 named Mandy has been going viral for being a total smokeshow, but fans are also noticing that she seems to have a dark secret.

Early on in the game, Brian sends Jason to go retrieve rent from a tenant named Mandy, who refuses to pay until her sink is fixed. Once you get there, it's clear she has staged a maintenance emergency so Jason would turn up. She's madly obsessed with him, but Jason pays no mind, since he's still pursuing Lucia. She eventually tries to seduce Jason with a skimpy bikini, to no avail. He ends up pulling out whatever is lodged in her sink, which she quickly takes and runs off with.

Mandy eventually gets irritated with Jason's disinterest and kicks him out, but if players linger around the property, they may start to realize Mandy isn't just obsessive because she has a crush... but because she may be a killer. If you wander into her backyard, you will see a freshly covered-up, body-sized hole next to a few tubs of acid. But hey, maybe it's just a coincidence! If you pop the trunk of her car, you will also see more acid and tools someone might use to kidnap and kill a person. And if you take a quick look at what was in Mandy's sink, it appears to be a severed finger.

While it's unclear if she's actually a serial killer (it takes three victims to be classified as one, by the way), she does appear to have killed at least one person. It's unclear who the other guy is, but it's possible Jason could've met a similar fate. Does she seduce people in order to kill them? Or does she kill them because they reject her advances or hurt her emotionally? It's hard to say. Either way, it seems clear that there's definitely a screw loose, and it's good that Jason didn't fall for her seduction.

items.title: You Can Now Buy the Steam Machine Without a Reservation – But Supplies Are Limited
items.description: Back when the Steam Machine first came out in June, it was in short supply, due to the limited amount of hardware Valve was able to get its hands on (thanks, RAM crisis). But now, about 5 months after launch, you can finally just buy a Steam Machine.
items.author: Jacqueline Thomas
items.content:
When the Steam Machine first came out in June, it was in short supply, due to the limited amount of hardware Valve was able to get its hands on (thanks, RAM crisis). Now, about 5 months after launch, you can finally just buy a Steam Machine.

Valve put out a blog post on November 19 giving an update on Steam Machine reservations, revealing that it had just finished out sending purchase invites to anyone on the reservation list for the 2TB model. The 512GB version, though, is now available to purchase on the Steam store page without a reservation. However, it looks like Valve doesn't have the components on hand to make the 2TB model available in the same way.

According to Valve's blog, the ongoing memory shortage is particularly impacting the 2TB Steam Machine because of its much larger drive. The company says the amount of people on the waitlist for the 2TB Machine exceeds what there were able to make, and while it's going to make more, it's going to be at a limited rate.

Still, Valve was able to get through its 512GB Steam Machine waitlist much earlier than expected. When the mini PC launched, some people were placed on the waitlist with an expected order time of 2027. Luckily, the new year hasn't ticked over, and the Machine is now available to buy for anyone that wants it... but there is a possibility that Valve will sell through its entire supply.

Valve does say that it's going to continue to build the Machine, but it sounds like the production run is going to be limited. It says that "memory and storage costs continue to increase at unprecedented levels; as a result, we don't yet know the number we are able to make, and at what price we'll be able to offer them."

It's no secret that the RAM crisis has been particularly unforgiving to the Steam Machine, and it's not likely to let up in the near future. Samsung told investors in an earnings call last month that it expects supply to be more constrained next year, and all three of the major RAM manufacturers have sold through their manufacturing capacity through next year.

It doesn't seem likely that the memory and storage costs that are limiting how many Steam Machines Valve can make will let up at all in the near future. From the way that blog post ended by saying it doesn't know how many Steam Machines it can make or how expensive they're going to be, it's very likely that the mini PC is either going to get a hearty price rise in January, or just be discontinued until Valve can make a followup when prices go down. Either way, it's a shame – the Steam Machine is an excellent little computer, and the RAM crisis unfortunately made it a non-starter for a lot of people, due to the price.

items.title: Video Game Spending Dropped 14% This October, Possibly Because Everyone Was Preparing for GTA 6
items.description: The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November.
items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:
The amount of money that players spent on video games this October fell 14%, and it’s little surprise that this coincided with the release of GTA 6 in November.

A new report from market research firm Circana shows that gamers were a bit more frugal this October than they were last year, despite two major games releasing that month. Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 launched on October 23, and Gears of War: E-Day released on October 1. Both games enjoyed reasonable critical reception, though reviews for Modern Warfare 4 were rather mixed.

It’s worth noting that sales for E-Day paled in comparison to the rave reviews it received, with analysts estimating that the game only sold 400,000 copies across both console and PC as of October 30. And last October, Battlefield 6 rocked players’ wallets as one of the best-selling games in the entire series — and, indeed, the best-selling game of the entire year — so it’s not a head-scratcher that this was a tough act for MW4 and E-Day to follow.

Circana’s report found that consumer spending on console, specifically, fell 18% from last year, and compared this trend to sales from Battlefield 6 and Pokémon Legends: Z-A. The report pointed to a 16% decline in mobile spending as the primary driver of this drop in addition to Battlefield's booming sales from last October.

However, it’s hard to ignore the impact that GTA 6 has had on the industry at large. Earlier this month, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick revealed that the release of the world’s most highly anticipated game likely had an impact on the lower-than-expected sales for NBA 2K27, as well as other titles.

“I do think that this timing may have affected performance so far,” he told IGN in an exclusive interview. “It has been a crowded period, and we do think that GTA 6 coming has had an influence on the consumer. That said, we're thrilled with how NBA 2K27 is performing.”

The launch of GTA 6 has proven to be a massive and unprecedented moment in pop culture history, to the point where analysts saw a 17% increase in time off requests for its release date on November 19. Even world governments were hopping on the bandwagon, with Australia’s workplace regulator reminding employees of their rights to PTO in a viral post last month. Germany also boasts a program that allows workers to take time off for professional development to play the game.

If that wasn’t wild enough, a U.S. Army Battalion even advertised a special reenlistment incentive that gave service members four days of paid leave that directly coincided with GTA 6’s release, which 43 soldiers ended up taking. It remains to be seen if GTA 6 will really save the average gamer $5,000 by staying indoors, but so many people have hopped online to play that internet service providers reported a massive spike in traffic from Xbox consoles.

items.title: Just Eat Reveals Gaming Controller With an Extra Button Just for Ordering Food
items.description: Just Eat is giving away a controller with a button dedicated to ordering food.
items.author: Blythe Dujardin
items.content:
Just Eat is giving away a controller with a button dedicated to ordering food.

The 'Stay in the Game' controller features what the food delivery company is calling a 'ChEAT' button under the standard diamond of action buttons. The limited-edition controller is only available through local giveaways in the U.K., and Just Eat has partnered with two local Twitch streamers for the promotion.

"When you’re deep into a high-stakes gaming session, nothing kills the moment faster than having to pause the action just to sort out food," said Tina Koehler, Just Eat's UK&I marketing director. "Just Eat has unlocked the ultimate hack to evade the kitchen, enabling gamers to stay just where they are and locked into play."

The company’s official UK accounts shared an AI-generated rendering of the controller, shown above, with the orange Just Eat feature on an otherwise very familiar looking peripheral. While the announcement doesn't offer any real information about the controller’s design or compatibility, it certainly looks quite a bit like PlayStation's standard DualSense.

Social media has plenty of thoughts about the reveal. While some users think the rendered controller looks surprisingly decent, with one claiming the grips "look better than a stock PS5 controller," others were quick to notice the button’s placement is, well, a little dangerous.

We don’t know how exactly the button works, but it most likely opens an external link to the Just Eat app or website. If it really did let you order food with the literal hit of a button, a couple slip-ups during a GTA car chase could lead to a pile of chicken nuggets at your door and a big dent in your wallet.

We’ll likely learn more when UK-based streamers Angry Ginge and Danny Aarons show off the new controller on Twitch. The two streamers are also how you’ll get your chance to use the controller yourself, as they’ll be sharing giveaway information across their social media accounts. Winners receive the limited-edition controller in addition to £300 in Just Eat credit.

The controller reveal coincides with the launch of GTA 6, as plenty of companies toy with the 'concern' that gamers won’t be able to take their eyes away from Leonida. Just this week, McDonald’s launched its own direct order app in Discord.

The majority of brands, however, have embraced the hype. Popeye’s just launched its own Vice City sandwich, and happens to be a major participant in however this Just Eat controller ends up working.

items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:

This new AI-focused studio will “develop proprietary technologies for gameplay to empower creators and open up new possibilities for richer, more immersive and engaging player experiences.”

Ubisoft explains that Motherbrain is focused on creating “new player experiences, smart NPCs with memory, and AI game masters that manage large-scale systemic worlds.” Motherbrain was founded to “serve creators globally, both within Ubisoft’s Creative House ecosystem and beyond, and form partnerships with selected technology actors.”

The existence of Teammates isn’t a surprise; Ubisoft revealed the project late last year, which some members of the media were able to play. It’s described as an immersive first-person shooter where players are accompanied by two robotic AI companions that they can order around using real-time voice commands.

Speaking with VideoGamesChronicle, Teammates’ narrative director Virginie Mosser described AI as a “tool,” positing that it isn’t something that will ultimately replace entire swaths of the industry. “It’s a tool first. The reveal of this AI-focused studio, however, comes amid sweeping layoffs for those within the games industry. Just today, Ubisoft announced another round of layoffs, hemorrhaging 116 jobs across two of its major studios. And earlier this year, 40 jobs were cut at its Toronto studio, coinciding with a change in leadership with the exit of former creative director Clint Hocking.

items.title: 'I’m So F**kin’ Bitter' — Doja Cat Begs Rockstar to Put Her Music on the GTA 6 Soundtrack
items.description: Doja Cat is extremely unhappy about getting passed over as a featured artist in GTA 6, and she’s making her feelings known in several blistering posts on social media.
items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:
Doja Cat is extremely unhappy about getting passed over as a featured artist in GTA 6, and she’s making her feelings known in several blistering posts on social media.

GTA 6, like other games in the series, features several different radio stations that players can scroll through as they zoom down the streets of Vice City. There’s oodles of licensed songs on these stations (we don’t even want to think about how costly this was for Rockstar to pull off), and PinkPantheress even hosts one as a DJ, which, of course, plays some of her music.

One artist who wasn’t included in the lineup was Doja Cat — who, as a gamer, was pretty pissed off about apparently getting snubbed by Rockstar for arguably the biggest game of the decade.

“I would’ve loved to have my music on GTA 6. I’m so f**kin’ bitter,” she wrote on Twitter/X on November 19. In another, she tagged the official Rockstar account, writing, “Eat my dick all yall, I love your stupid f**kin’ bitch-ass game.” She tagged them again in a third post, saying, “You broke my heart, pinche culero.”

As previously mentioned, Doja Cat is an avid gamer. She regularly streams on Twitch between recording new albums and touring, often choosing to play a few games of Fortnite while chatting with her audience. She’s even referenced the game in one of her songs (Agora Hills), and also included a cute line referencing the ‘We got xyz before GTA 6’ meme in her song ‘All Mine.’

Needless to say, Doja’s expletive-ridden tweets quickly went viral, attracting no end of discourse from both fans and critics about what artists got featured in the game and those who missed out. Others were quick to remind her that GTA 5 added new songs to its radio station later in the game’s lifetime, so there’s still a chance that she might get to be in the game at some point further down the line.

“They added newer songs on the radio later in GTA 5, so there’s still a chance sis,” one user commented.

“You’re actually a gamer, too, that’s why I feel bad,” another lamented.

“They added music over time to GTA 5. They might do it again. Start campaigning sis,” another encouraged.

GTA 6’s soundtrack features a slew of high-profile music artists, with the likes of Cardi B, Tame Impala, Travis Scott, and Keith Richards being just a few who contributed to the project. Fans can buy the physical soundtrack as a collectible vinyl album, which can be pre-ordered on the IGN store right now.

items.title: GTA 6's Jason and Lucia Actors Break Years of Silence With New Joint Statement
items.description: GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez, have broken their multi-year streak of silence about being in the game.
items.author: Cade Onder
items.content:
GTA 6's lead actors, Dylan Rourke and Manni L. Perez, have broken their multi-year streak of silence about starring in the game.

With GTA 6 officially being out now, the game's full cast has officially been announced. Rockstar kept the actors under a veil of secrecy for the better part of a decade, though some fans were able to figure out who they were thanks to some sleuthing. Still, despite this, the actors maintained strong poker faces, and it's honestly commendable how well they kept their roles under wraps. To celebrate the game's launch, Rourke (who plays Jason) and Perez (who plays Lucia) released a joint statement on their Instagram accounts about their experience working on the game.

"Years witnessing the hardest working and most skilled artisans game making has to offer," reads their statement. "We are truly honored to collaborate on this worldwide testament to human creativity, ingenuity, and sheer willpower. So much learned and so much to learn, keep fighting for what you love, stay humble. See y’all in Leonida."

Perez's role was technically confirmed earlier this week when she was nominated for Best Performance at The Game Awards. Jason and Lucia have been receiving all kinds of praise for their hyper-detailed relationship, which allows players to roleplay a romantic and nuanced kinship. There hasn't really been anything quite like it in gaming, though that has also led to some annoyance from a certain group of fans who just want a straight-up crime game without the lovey-dovey fluff.

Still, there is plenty of crime to be found in this game, obviously. GTA 6's sketchy cast of characters is supported by plenty of new, up-and-coming talent along with some more familiar faces like Bobby Moynihan and Stephen Root (who leaked his own role earlier this year). Whether this will catapult Perez and Rourke into more mainstream roles following GTA 6 remains to be seen. GTA 5's Steven Ogg (who played Trevor) was cast in shows like The Walking Dead and Better Call Saul following the game's release. Given GTA 6 is likely going to have the biggest launch in entertainment history, these two actors are about to become some of the most recognizable faces and voices in gaming.

items.title: Furry Community Divided by GTA 6 Parody
items.description: Furries are at odds as to whether or not GTA 6's satirical take on anti-Furry sentiment is harmful to public perception of their community.
items.author: Virginia Glaze
items.content:
Warning: Mild spoilers for a GTA 6 below!

The Grand Theft Auto franchise is known for parodying aspects of American culture, but one particular bit of satire in GTA 6 is causing a divide in the Furry community.

In the fictional world of GTA 6, being a Furry is illegal. In fact, licensed hunters in Leonida — GTA’s tongue-in-cheek take on Florida — are authorized to “shoot any Furry on sight.” Of course, it’s obvious that the developers at Rockstar were merely poking fun at recent anti-Furry sentiment from the likes of Florida governor Ron DeSantis, but some real-life Furries are worried that this satire might be taken literally by young players.

For instance, a public service announcement from the “Anti-Furry Association" plays on a television channel in the game warning players about the supposed “dangers” of furries, reminding them that “all citizens are required to report any suspicious activity.” This includes phrases and slang that are popular within the Furry community, like “Uwu, Rawr XD,” and “Hewwo.”

Scrolling through the game’s social media apps, players will also come across a news article from the Vice City Horn titled, “Governor Declares Leonida Furry-Free.” Its headline is accompanied by an image of a crying Furry peeking out from behind a red ‘no’ symbol.

The most viral facet in this conversation concerns an in-game event that players come upon at night. In this event, police are in a standoff with a Furry, who taunts the cops training their guns on him as helicopters fly overhead. Players can choose to help save the Furry from law enforcement or watch him get riddled with bullets if they don’t feel like coming to his rescue.

Some members of the Furry community aren’t taking it too seriously. On X/Twitter, where the bulk of this debate is taking place, a Furry user by the name Freaking_Flynn wrote, “I love it, but I feel like this joke would fit more in the Saints Row series than in the world of GTA. But anywho, Furries going mainstream!”

“I can't believe this is real, and I unironically love it,” another Furry netizen named Riley said of the game’s Furry encounter. Commenters beneath their post seem largely in agreement, with many pointing out how the fictional Furry taunted officers to “suck his knot.”

Others, however, are worried about the broader message GTA 6’s satirical take on anti-Furry panic might color public perception of the community. On Twitter, a Furry user named Kineon wrote, “I love GTA and understand this is meant as satire. However, as a Florida-based furry who already deals with regular hate and threats, I’m genuinely concerned that this could end up encouraging more real-world hostility and violence toward us."

“I get this game is supposed to be satire.. But to be blatantly honest... This is just encouraging more hatred, as well as allowing people who don't like Furries to encourage bad intentions, such as actually shooting one in-person,” another Furry user named Venus said. “Considering the fact that there are children who play this series and are being encouraged to do illegal crimes (which yes, it's a video game but still) it's not exactly healthy for such things to be promoted.”

I had the privilege of speaking with a member of the Furry community to get their opinion on the matter. Riley — whose comments we included earlier in this article — elaborated on how they felt about being represented in GTA 6, saying they believe most Furries understand the joke and are generally appreciative of being referenced in one of the biggest pop culture moments of the decade.

“I think speaking on behalf of the furry community can be a little tricky, because we're definitely a community that can be quick to jump on a bandwagon and criticize opinions we disagree with. But in this particular case, I genuinely think most furries understand that it's a joke and are actually really happy to be acknowledged in such a massive cultural moment as the release of GTA 6,” they told me.

“There's something genuinely hilarious about furries being ‘banned’ in Leonida, especially when you consider that the game also gives players the opportunity to help these furries escape from the police and reach a hideout,” they continued. “It's exactly the kind of ridiculous social satire that GTA has always been known for, and I think most of us appreciate being included in it, even if we're technically the butt of the joke!

“I also think there's something really special about furry culture being represented in a game this massive. Whether Rockstar intended it or not, GTA 6 will probably introduce millions of people to the fandom and, unironically, might even inspire an entirely new generation of future furries. Which honestly makes the whole situation even funnier to me.”

Ultimately, Riley felt this situation doesn’t need to “become a serious debate” about the Furry community; instead, it’s just another example of how Rockstar reflects modern American culture in GTA games with “its signature, over-the-top humor.”

I also reached out to SonicFox, one of the world's best professional fighting game players and a notable member of the Furry community, who shared a similar sentiment. "I think it’s clearly satire and very apparent what political group GTA is making fun of," they told me.
